# Wikilink Forms — all four forms through write, links, and lint

# A wikilink has two readers: CEL builds `page.ast.links` at write time, and the
# link graph records a row per target when the page is indexed. Both must report
# the same target for every form. The probe template carries one rule — the body
# must link the target named by `expect_target` — so a page writes only when CEL
# read the target the link graph is about to record.

# --- Setup ---

exec akb init wk-kb
cd wk-kb

# init seeds no templates: copy the note template for the linked-to page, and
# the probe template whose rule pins the CEL view of a wikilink target.
exec akb template get note --full --examples
cp stdout .akb/templates/note.yaml
cp ../probe-template.yaml .akb/templates/probe.yaml
exec git add .akb/templates
exec git commit -m 'seed note and probe templates'

stdin ../target-note.md
exec akb write notes/probe-target.md
stdout 'Written to kb/notes/probe-target.md'

# --- FORM 1: [[target]] — target and display are both "probe-target" ---

stdin ../plain.md
exec akb write probes/plain.md
stdout 'Written to kb/probes/plain.md'

exec akb links probes/plain.md
stdout 'Outbound:'
stdout '  probe-target -> kb/notes/probe-target.md'
stdout 'Broken:'

# --- FORM 2: [[target|display]] — the pipe display is never the target ---

stdin ../display.md
exec akb write probes/display.md
stdout 'Written to kb/probes/display.md'

exec akb links probes/display.md
stdout '  probe-target -> kb/notes/probe-target.md'

# --- FORM 3: [[target#heading]] — the heading is never the target ---

stdin ../heading.md
exec akb write probes/heading.md
stdout 'Written to kb/probes/heading.md'

exec akb links probes/heading.md
stdout '  probe-target -> kb/notes/probe-target.md'

# --- FORM 4: [[display]](dest) — the destination beats the bracket label ---

# CEL reports the destination as written (notes/probe-target.md); the link
# graph stores the normalized destination (notes/probe-target) and resolves it
# to the same page.
stdin ../explicit.md
exec akb write probes/explicit.md
stdout 'Written to kb/probes/explicit.md'

exec akb links probes/explicit.md
stdout '  notes/probe-target -> kb/notes/probe-target.md'

# --- CEL refuses a declared target the body does not link ---

stdin ../mismatch.md
! exec akb write probes/mismatch.md
stderr 'link_target_matches_expect_target'
stderr 'body must link the target named by expect_target'
! exists kb/probes/mismatch.md

# --- LINT: the four forms leave no broken link behind ---

# Every issue here is a warning (orphans, index_consistency), so lint still
# exits 0 — what matters is that no broken_links issue is among them.
exec akb lint
! stdout 'broken_links'

# --- LINT: the target CEL matched is the target lint reports broken ---

stdin ../broken.md
exec akb write probes/broken.md
stdout 'Written to kb/probes/broken.md'

exec akb links probes/broken.md
stdout 'Broken:'
stdout '  missing-target'

! exec akb lint
stdout 'broken_links'
stdout 'broken link to \[\[missing-target\]\]'

-- probe-template.yaml --
name: probe
description: Wikilink probe — one rule pinning the CEL view of a wikilink target
dir: probes
schema:
  frontmatter:
    title:
      type: string
      required: true
    type:
      type: string
      required: true
    expect_target:
      type: string
      required: true
validations:
  - id: link_target_matches_expect_target
    rule: 'page.ast.links.exists(l, l.is_wikilink && l.target == page.frontmatter.expect_target)'
    requirement: The body must link the target named by expect_target
    expect: body must link the target named by expect_target

-- target-note.md --
---
type: note
title: Probe Target
summary: The page every wikilink form resolves to
---

# Probe Target

A page for the four wikilink forms to resolve to.

-- plain.md --
---
type: probe
title: Plain wikilink
expect_target: probe-target
---

# Plain wikilink

The bare form links [[probe-target]] by name.

-- display.md --
---
type: probe
title: Display wikilink
expect_target: probe-target
---

# Display wikilink

The piped form links [[probe-target|Probe Target]] and names its own display text.

-- heading.md --
---
type: probe
title: Heading wikilink
expect_target: probe-target
---

# Heading wikilink

The heading form links [[probe-target#Rationale]] and names its own heading.

-- explicit.md --
---
type: probe
title: Explicit destination wikilink
expect_target: notes/probe-target.md
---

# Explicit destination wikilink

The explicit-destination form links [[Probe Target]](notes/probe-target.md): the
bracket carries the label, the parens carry the destination.

-- mismatch.md --
---
type: probe
title: Mismatched target
expect_target: some-other-target
---

# Mismatched target

The link and the declared target disagree: [[probe-target]].

-- broken.md --
---
type: probe
title: Broken wikilink
expect_target: missing-target
---

# Broken wikilink

The link has no page behind it: [[missing-target]].
